coded.vi: Perekrut wajib berizin, dan hukum menjadikan agensi bertanggung jawab bersama majikan asing atas klaim pekerja
coded.vl: Recruiters must be licensed, and the law makes the agency liable jointly with the foreign employer for the worker's claims
coded.n: Recruitment agencies are licensed by the Department of Migrant Workers and are jointly and severally liable with the employer for claims; corporate officers are personally liable.
coded.src: RA 8042 s. 10 as amended by RA 10022 s. 7; RA 11641 s. 3(h) · official text: https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/18116

coded.fi: Biaya rekrutmen yang dibebankan kepada pekerja
coded.vi: Biaya dibatasi oleh hukum, atau dilarang hanya untuk jabatan atau negara tujuan tertentu
coded.vl: Fees are capped by law, or prohibited only for listed occupations or destinations
coded.n: The 2023 DMW Landbased Rules cap the placement fee at one month's basic salary and bar it for domestic workers and where the destination bars fees; the employer pays visa, airfare and government fees. Seafarers are governed by the 2026 Seabased Rules. The statute itself sets no amount (official guidance).
coded.src: DMW Department Circular 01 s. 2023 ss. 56–59; DC 06 s. 2026 s. 54 · official guidance: https://dmw.gov.ph/archives/v1/resources/dsms/DMW/ISN-EXT/2023/DMW-DC-01-2023.pdf

coded.vi: Kontrak tertulis dengan syarat minimum yang ditetapkan atau diverifikasi negara wajib bagi setiap pekerja sebelum berangkat
coded.vl: A written contract with minimum terms set or verified by the state is required for every worker before departure
coded.n: Migrant Workers Offices verify contracts, and approval requires a joint-liability clause; standard contracts per type of hire are set by DMW rules.
coded.src: RA 11641 s. 15(b); RA 8042 ss. 6(i), 10 · official text: https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/94035

coded.vi: Orientasi tentang hak dan saluran pengaduan wajib dan gratis bagi pekerja
coded.vl: Orientation on rights and complaint channels is compulsory and free of charge to the worker
coded.n: Pre-employment and pre-departure orientation are mandatory under the DMW Landbased Rules (s. 169) and Seabased Rules (s. 202). The pre-employment seminar is free; pre-departure orientation may also be given by accredited private providers, so 'free of charge' is only partly established (official guidance).
coded.src: DMW DC 01 s. 2023 s. 169; DC 06 s. 2026 s. 202 · official guidance: https://wcms.dmw.gov.ph/uploads/DMW_DC_06_2026_188f50990f.pdf

coded.vi: Dana berdasarkan undang-undang atau asuransi wajib mencakup semua pekerja terdaftar untuk kematian, cacat dan pemulangan, serta membiayai bantuan hukum atau kesejahteraan di luar negeri
coded.vl: A statutory fund or compulsory insurance covers all registered workers for death, disability and repatriation, and funds legal or welfare assistance abroad
coded.n: OWWA Fund with compulsory membership covering death, disability, repatriation and legal assistance; compulsory insurance for agency-hired workers at no cost to the worker.
coded.src: RA 10801 ss. 4, 6(b), 8, 35; RA 8042 s. 37-A (RA 10022 s. 23) · official text: https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/67104

coded.vl: A statute requires labor or welfare officers in missions in the main destination countries
coded.n: Migrant Workers Offices are to be set up at all posts, as far as practicable, with priority for countries with many Filipino workers; they absorb the former POLO and OSWA.

coded.vi: Badan khusus di dalam negeri dapat memberi ganti rugi kepada pekerja terhadap perekrut (dan majikan asing) atas pelanggaran selama rekrutmen atau kerja
coded.vl: A specialized body at home can award compensation to workers against recruiters (and employers abroad) for breaches during recruitment or employment
coded.n: Labor arbiters of the NLRC have original and exclusive jurisdiction over claims arising from overseas employment, with joint and several liability; the DMW adjudicates recruitment violations.
coded.src: RA 8042 s. 10 as amended; RA 11641 ss. 8(j), 9(c) · official text: https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/18116

coded.fn: Exit without sex- or age-specific restrictions
coded.fi: Keberangkatan tanpa pembatasan khusus jenis kelamin atau usia
coded.vi: Pembatasan menurut negara tujuan atau jabatan, atau usia minimum di atas 18, yang netral gender secara tertulis
coded.vl: Restrictions by destination or occupation, or minimum ages above 18, that are sex-neutral on their face
coded.n: The minimum age for household service workers is 23 for all genders (POEA GBR 2 s. 2007, lowering the 25 set in 2006; exemptions under GBR 4 s. 2011). Deployment to destinations can be restricted or banned (RA 8042 ss. 4–5; RA 11641 s. 8(k)); for Kuwait, deployment of first-time domestic workers has been deferred since 2023, and from 2024 only domestic workers with prior overseas experience may go (official guidance).

changes.en: Migrant Workers and Overseas Filipinos Act (RA 8042) adopted after the execution of Flor Contemplacion in Singapore.
Ratifies the UN migrant workers convention.
RA 10022 strengthens RA 8042: compulsory insurance, certification of destination countries.
Ratifies ILO C189 on domestic workers, the second state to do so.
OWWA Act (RA 10801) puts the welfare fund on a statutory footing.
Agreement with Kuwait on domestic workers after a deployment ban.
Department of Migrant Workers Act (RA 11641) creates a dedicated department.
Ratifies ILO C190 on violence and harassment in the world of work.

dec.n: Philippine Association of Service Exporters v. Drilon
dec.pe: The Philippines stopped sending women abroad as domestic workers because of abuse. Recruitment agencies challenged the ban. The Supreme Court upheld it.
dec.pi: Filipina menghentikan pengiriman perempuan sebagai pekerja rumah tangga karena banyak kekerasan. Agen perekrut menggugat larangan itu. MA mempertahankannya.

dec.n: JMM Promotion and Management v. Court of Appeals
dec.pe: After a Filipina performer died in Japan, the government added training and a record book for performers going abroad. Agencies said this was unfair. The Supreme Court upheld the rule.
dec.pi: Setelah seorang penghibur Filipina meninggal di Jepang, pemerintah menambah pelatihan dan buku catatan bagi penghibur yang ke luar negeri. Agen menyebutnya tidak adil. MA mempertahankan aturan itu.

dec.n: Macalintal v. Commission on Elections (overseas absentee voting)
dec.pe: A lawyer challenged the new law letting Filipinos abroad vote. The Supreme Court upheld the right of overseas workers to vote from abroad.
dec.pi: Seorang advokat menggugat UU baru yang membolehkan warga Filipina di luar negeri memilih. MA mempertahankan hak pekerja di luar negeri untuk memilih dari luar negeri.

dec.pe: A Filipina sent to Saudi Arabia was made to sign a new contract with worse pay and work. The Supreme Court said the agency in the Philippines must pay what she lost.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan Filipina yang dikirim ke Arab Saudi dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah dan pekerjaan lebih buruk. MA menyatakan agen di Filipina wajib membayar kerugiannya.

dec.pe: A Filipino seafarer was sent home before his contract ended. The law limited what he could claim to three months’ pay. The Supreme Court said this limit treated overseas workers unfairly and struck it down, so he could claim pay for the rest of his contract.
dec.pi: Seorang pelaut Filipina dipulangkan sebelum kontraknya berakhir. Undang-undang membatasi tuntutannya hanya tiga bulan gaji. Mahkamah Agung menyatakan batas itu tidak adil bagi pekerja luar negeri dan membatalkannya, sehingga ia bisa menuntut gaji sampai akhir kontrak.

dec.pe: A young Filipina nurse died in Saudi Arabia and the employer called it suicide. Her parents sued. The Supreme Court held the recruitment agency and the employer liable to the family.
dec.pi: Seorang perawat muda Filipina meninggal di Arab Saudi dan majikan menyebutnya bunuh diri. Orang tuanya menggugat. MA menyatakan agen dan majikan bertanggung jawab kepada keluarga.

dec.pe: A Filipino seafarer was let go early when his ship was sold. The Supreme Court applied its earlier Serrano ruling and said he must be paid for the rest of his contract.
dec.pi: Seorang pelaut Filipina diberhentikan lebih awal ketika kapalnya dijual. MA menerapkan putusan Serrano dan menyatakan ia harus dibayar untuk sisa kontraknya.

dec.pe: Women from the Philippines were promised jobs in Malaysia but were forced into prostitution. The Supreme Court upheld the recruiters’ convictions.
dec.pi: Perempuan dari Filipina dijanjikan pekerjaan di Malaysia tetapi dipaksa melacur. MA menguatkan vonis terhadap para perekrut.

dec.n: PERT/CPM Manpower Exponent Co. v. Vinuya
dec.pe: Filipino workers sent abroad were made to sign new contracts with lower pay than promised, then quit and came home. The Supreme Court said they had effectively been dismissed and the agency had to pay.
dec.pi: Pekerja Filipina yang dikirim ke luar negeri dipaksa menandatangani kontrak baru dengan upah lebih rendah dari yang dijanjikan, lalu berhenti dan pulang. MA menyatakan mereka pada dasarnya dipecat dan agen harus membayar.

dec.pe: Recruitment agencies argued it was unfair to make their directors personally pay workers’ claims. The Supreme Court said the rule is valid because it protects workers abroad.
dec.pi: Agen perekrut berpendapat tidak adil membuat direkturnya membayar sendiri tuntutan pekerja. MA menyatakan aturan itu sah karena melindungi pekerja di luar negeri.

dec.n: Sameer Overseas Placement Agency v. Cabiles
dec.pe: A woman recruited in the Philippines for factory work in Taiwan was sent home early. The Supreme Court said the limit on her claim was still unfair, even though Congress had written it into the law again, and that the agency that recruited her must pay together with the employer.
dec.pi: Seorang perempuan yang direkrut di Filipina untuk bekerja di pabrik di Taiwan dipulangkan lebih awal. MA menyatakan batas tuntutannya tetap tidak adil, walaupun Kongres sudah menuliskannya lagi dalam undang-undang, dan agen yang merekrutnya wajib membayar bersama majikan.

dec.pe: A foreign airline forced Filipino cabin crew to resign when they became pregnant. The Supreme Court said they could sue at home and that their dismissal was unlawful.
dec.pi: Sebuah maskapai asing memaksa awak kabin Filipina mengundurkan diri saat hamil. MA menyatakan mereka boleh menggugat di negaranya sendiri dan pemecatan itu tidak sah.
